label: Graph sourceDiversity reads 0.00 because it counts distinct metadata.quality_class values on cited SOURCE nodes per QUESTION, and no producer (prompt contract, agent, YAML, runtime) ever sets quality_class; only tests do.
Two different metrics share the name sourceDiversity: the quality guard (sources per answered question) and the graph signal (distinct quality classes); the dashboard 0.00 is the graph signal.
Iteration 4 F14 settled: buildStopDecisionInput builds evidenceRecords from stateLogRows, which lack keyQuestions, so focusAlignment is notEvaluated on research runs.
Leaf-emitted graph events are inconsistent across this run (17, 20, 1, 0 node events in deltas 1-4), so leaf QUESTION nodes cannot be the frontier source of truth.
Frontier node schema: id, parentId, depth, kind, loopType, scope, narrow-only budget slice, status open|active|answered|blocked|exhausted|abstained|pruned, statusReason, provenance, dedupeKey.

Frontier storage: workflow-written inbox.jsonl rows (origin frontier) as admission log, a reducer-built registry frontier projection read by the stop veto, and workflow-upserted coverage-graph QUESTION nodes; leaf only emits frontier_proposal delta rows.

Target 1 decomposition (review): prune 20 merges and 32 chore(system-spec-kit) trigger-index rebuilds, 7 subsystem nodes from path clusters, batch nodes of <=10 commits and code-doc drift-pair nodes, evidence-only depth-3 questions, layered fan-in.

Target 2 decomposition (research): prompt-policy gate (short_casual_acknowledgement, below_prompt_policy_threshold are the chat losses), command surfacing (COMMAND_POLICIES, DEPTH_WORDING), scorer, hook adapters, chat-intent taxonomy; routing-and-scoring 001-010 as dedupe set.

Admission order: relevance gate (evidence anchor + scope intersection), dedupe (frontier, registry, rejected patterns, exhausted approaches), depth cap 3, fan-out caps 6 per node and 40 per run, monotone budget slice, acyclicity; post-admission exhausted closure returns budget to parent.
Depth budget splits maxIterations geometrically by depth (50/35/15), unused share rolls down, spent depth closes open nodes as exhausted:budget.

Frontier-exhaustion veto sits after the minIterations floor beside quality guards, only converts STOP to CONTINUE while frontier nodes are open and depth budget remains, never creates STOP, keeps hard stops first, closes stuck nodes locally, reads only registry frontier and graph; graph sourceDiversity must report notEvaluated under the mode.
Under the mode Next Focus picks open frontier nodes by lowest depth, uncovered, oldest admission, which also removes the Questions Remaining free-text takeover.
Fan-out partitions open depth-1 frontier nodes across flat-pool lineages with distinct scopes and a fan-in input-count guard.
